title: GSTAT Vacancy Alert: Ministry of Finance Invites Applications for Officers on Deputation
content:
# GSTAT Vacancy Alert: Ministry of Finance Invites Applications for Officers on Deputation

Ek important update hai! Ministry of Finance, Department of Revenue, ne Goods and Services Tax Appellate Tribunal (GSTAT) mein various posts ke liye applications invite ki hain. Ye recruitment deputation basis par ki ja rahi hai.

*   **Vacancy Circular Details:** This invitation is based on Vacancy Circular No. A-12/4/2024-GSTAT-DOR-DOR-Part (3) dated November 6, 2026.
*   **Posts Offered:** A total of 237 tentative vacancies across 13 designations have been announced, including Stenographer Grade I, Court Officer, Assistant, Upper Division Clerk (UDC), Financial Advisor, Joint Registrar, Deputy Registrar, and more.
*   **Eligibility:** Only serving officers and officials from the Central Government, State Governments, Union Territories, and Tribunals (and for some posts, other public bodies like autonomous bodies, PSUs, courts, and universities) are eligible to apply, as these positions are on a deputation basis.
*   **Application Period:**
    *   **Online Application Starts:** November 15, 2026
    *   **Application Deadline:** December 15, 2026 (within 30 days from the start date).
*   **How to Apply:** Applications must be submitted online through the portal.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://dor.gov.in/sites/default/files/Vacancy_GSTAT.pdf)

*Published on: 10 November 2026*
